subject: Lodge
text: The Lodge sells Lime Cider for 20 Gold.

subject: Inn
text: Staying at the Inn in Treck costs 10 Gold.

subject: Former Guy Legion knight
text: A former Guy Legion knight resides in the house west of the entrance to Treck.

evidence.quote:
Head to the house west of the entrance, and speak with the former Guy Legion 
knight.

subject: Aguro
text: Speaking to the green-haired man at the docks triggers a battle against four Demon Lords, during which Aguro joins the party.

evidence.quote:
Next go to the docks and speak to the guy with green hair. When you 
regain control of your characters, you'll be in a battle against four Demon 
Lords. But fear not Aguro joins you.

subject: Demon Lords
text: Because the four Demon Lords cast Magic Mirror, players must rely on physical attacks to defeat them.

evidence.quote:
The Demon Lord's use the Magic Mirror 
spell so you'll have to use physical attacks against them. Just keep up the 
physical attacks, heal if needed, and you should do fine.

subject: Cave
text: A chest containing a potion is found up the rope ladder near the entrance of the cave.

evidence.quote:
Walk east upon entering and go up the rope ladder. Open the chest for a potion 
and take the stairs down.

subject: Transports
text: The north transporter leads to panels that restore HP and MP, while the south transporter warps back to the entrance.

evidence.quote:
Notice the transports, The north one's path leads 
to panels which restore your HP and MP, and the south one transports you back 
to the entrance.

subject: Cave
text: A chest containing a potion is located to the southeast in the cave.

evidence.quote:
Walk southeast now where you'll find two more chests, one 
contains a potion and the other a power potion.

subject: Cave
text: A chest containing a power potion is located to the southeast in the cave.

evidence.quote:
Walk southeast now where you'll find two more chests, one 
contains a potion and the other a power potion.

subject: Mud
text: Walking on mud inside the cave causes damage to the party.

evidence.quote: Avoid the mud because it causes damage.

subject: Cave
text: A chest behind a southern door in the cave contains a daze ring.

evidence.quote: Walk south and enter the door to find a chest containing a daze ring.

subject: Goblins
text: Against the three Goblins on the boat Maberia, Hero and Aguro should use constant physical attacks while Lufia concentrates on healing.

evidence.quote:
When you walk up to the boat there's a little dialogue and then you're 
attacked by three Goblins. You'll definitely have to heal during this battle 
so be prepared. I recommend constant physical attacks from Hero and Aguro, 
while Lufia concentrates on healing.

subject: Treck
text: Speaking twice with the Maberia's Captain on the second floor of the lodge in Treck departs for Lorbenia.

evidence.quote:
After that, head west to the lodge and speak with the Maberia's 
Captain on the second floor. When you regain control of your characters, speak 
with the Captain again and you're off to Lorbenia.

subject: Jeweler
text: The Jeweler in Lorbenia sells Necklaces for 100 Gold.

evidence.quote: | Necklace     |   100 |

subject: Armorer's Shop
text: The Armorer's Shop in Lorbenia sells Cloth Shoes for 300 Gold.

evidence.quote: | Cloth Shoes  |   300 |

subject: Merchant's Shop 1
text: Merchant's Shop 1 in Lorbenia sells Sweet Water for 10 Gold.

evidence.quote: | Sweet Water  |    10 |

subject: Aguro
text: Aguro temporarily leaves the party upon arrival in Lorbenia.

evidence.quote: Upon reaching Lorbenia, Aguro leaves you for a short while.

subject: Weapons Shop
text: Searching the bookshelf in the southwestern Weapons Shop in Lorbenia yields a mid arrow.

evidence.quote:
Head to the 
Weapons Shop, it's the southwestern most building. The bookshelf contains a 
mid arrow.

subject: Merchant's Shops building
text: A chest upstairs to the southeast inside the Merchant's Shops building in Lorbenia contains sweet water.

evidence.quote:
Head west to the 
building with the two Merchant's Shops. Go into the back and head up either 
flight of stairs. Go southeast and open the chest for a sweet water, and then 
take the stairs up to the third floor.

subject: Aguro
text: Aguro rejoins the party as you exit the inn in Lorbenia.

evidence.quote:
When you regain control of your characters,
head to the inn and speak to the innkeeper. As you exit whether you decided to 
rest or not, Aguro will rejoin you.

subject: Lorbenia
text: Exiting Lorbenia and heading southwest leads to Grenoble.

evidence.quote:
When you're ready to move on, exit Lorbenia and head southwest to
Grenoble.

subject: Merchant's Shop
text: The Merchant's Shop in Grenoble sells Stone Cure for 100 Gold.

evidence.quote: | Stone Cure   |   100 |

subject: Inn
text: Staying at the Inn in Grenoble costs 40 Gold.

subject: Weapons Shop
text: Searching the bookshelf in the western Weapons Shop in Grenoble reveals a potion.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering Grenoble, head west to the Weapons Shop and search the bookshelf
for a potion.

subject: Secret Map
text: Paying 50 gold pieces in the northwest building allows access to the basement treasure hunter shop where you can accept the Secret Map treasure hunt.

evidence.quote:
Next go to the northwest building and pay the guy 50 gold pieces
to pass. Go down the stairs and follow the path to a flight of stairs which 
takes you outside to another flight of stairs. Down the stairs you'll find the
treasure hunter shop. Speak to the old man, then the guy behind the counter 
and accept the "Secret Map" treasure hunt.

subject: Old Cave 2nd Floor
text: Searching three panels south of the chest located between two toxic marshes reveals a hidden ex potion.

evidence.quote:
When you see the chest in between the two toxic
marshes, proceed 3 panels south of it and search for a hidden ex potion.

subject: Old Cave 2nd Floor
text: Inside a room south on the second floor of the Old Cave, a chest contains a power ring.

evidence.quote:
Enter
the door when you reach it where you'll find two chests, they contain a power
ring and the secret map.

subject: Old Cave 2nd Floor
text: Inside a room south on the second floor of the Old Cave, a chest contains the secret map.

evidence.quote: Enter the door when you reach it where you'll find two chests, they contain a power ring and the secret map. Equip the power ring on one of your characters and backtrack to the 2nd floor entrance.

subject: Old Cave 2nd Floor
text: Proceeding west and south on the second floor reveals two chests surrounded by toxic marsh, one of which contains a dragon egg.

evidence.quote:
Proceed west and then south to find two 
chests surrounded by toxic marsh. They contain a dragon egg and a tan shield.

subject: Old Cave 2nd Floor
text: A chest surrounded by toxic marsh to the west and south on the second floor contains a tan shield.

evidence.quote:
Proceed west and then south to find two 
chests surrounded by toxic marsh. They contain a dragon egg and a tan shield.

subject: Old Cave 2nd Floor
text: Inside the women-only room accessed by Lufia, a chest contains the fairy kiss treasure.

evidence.quote:
Read the sign 
next to it and you'll see that only women can enter. Now as Lufia we enter the 
room where you'll find five chests. They contain the "fairy kiss", a dress, 
hair band, earring, and heeled shoes.

subject: Old Cave 2nd Floor
text: One of the five chests in the women-only room contains a dress.

evidence.quote:
Now as Lufia we enter the 
room where you'll find five chests. They contain the "fairy kiss", a dress, 
hair band, earring, and heeled shoes.
